title: H-CARSTACK-1 confirming test (LOG-ONLY probe, user-approved 2026-09-24) - both players run their OWN traffic and then MEET. The client is put on a road lane far from the host (well past the 350 m traffic-apart ring) and runs its own Gley traffic (local mode); the HOST then walks in by road-snapped steps (about 240 m, 150 m, 80 m, then beside the client) with pauses, so the client's local cars are still around it when the host's ghosts arrive; hold together 100 s. The probe prints, on the switch to ghost mode and every 2 s of the handover, an HCARS summary (local cars / in view / keepable / gone / longest survivor / arrival gate) and up to 12 HCAR lines (per local car: model, distance, in-view, keep/retire, seconds survived, nearest ghost + dY). PREMISE (asserted at the end): the switch to ghost mode happened while the client had >= 3 local cars in view. Every PAIR line is reported with its dY; nothing is asserted about pairs. NO save.
preconditions: Fixture save1 (host melaus, Client1; both avatars spawn outdoors near (65, -194)). Dev build (tp / tproad / traffic levers are BAMP_DEV only). 'tproad x z' (added 2026-09-24) snaps to the NEAREST Gley traffic waypoint by x/z and faces along its lane. Far point (-500, -150), about 565 m west of the spawn. Run 1 (2026-09-24 01:05) proved the OLD far point (999.7, -99.4) is OFF the Gley road network: its nearest traffic waypoint is 599.7 m away at (400, 0, -99.4) - so step 8 also asserts the snap is under 40 m. The host's steps are offsets from the client's snapped position toward the spawn (direction about (+0.997, -0.078)).

expect_log.regex: \[TrafficSync\] snapshots on the (unreliable|reliable) lane \(seq-guarded\); identity re-send every 5s\.

steps.note: both worlds load and settle; the host evaluates a mode for the peer on its 0.2 s beat
PREMISE: the client is outdoors (tproad refuses inside a building or a vehicle), ON a road lane, and far from the host

expect_log.regex: \[TrafficSync\] traffic mode: local \(seq \d+\) - this client is far from every other player
\[TrafficSync\] traffic mode: local (\(ghosts handed over in|- \d+ ghost\(s\) still on screen)

steps.note: the client's own Gley traffic fills in around it at the game's density

PREMISE: local mode really in force with >= 3 local cars alive around the client. The client's log is searched from THIS step's mark by every later host step's expect_log (no client command runs until step 20).
host about 240 m from the client, on a road (the local->ghost switch fires below 250 m)
host about 150 m from the client, on a road
host about 80 m from the client, on a road
host beside the client, on a road
hold together: the handover keeps in-view local cars within 70 m up to its 90 s ceiling; the probe prints every 2 s while it runs
PREMISE (asserted on the CLIENT log from step 10's mark): the switch to ghost mode happened, and at that moment >= 3 local cars were in view

expect_log.regex: \[TrafficSync\] traffic mode: ghost \(seq \d+\) - another player is near
\[CarStack\] HCARS trig=switch-to-ghost age=0\.0s pass=\d+ local=\d+ inView=([3-9]|[1-9]\d+)
